sloka: अलब्धवरपूर्वेण यत्कृतं राक्षसेन तु ।तदेष वरलब्धः स्याद्भक्षयेद्भुवनत्रयम् ।। ७.१०.३९ ॥
transliteration: alabdhavarapūrveṇa yatkṛtaṁ rākṣasena tu ।tadeṣa varalabdhaḥ syādbhakṣayedbhuvanatrayam ।। 7.10.39 ॥

translations.english: Whatever was done by the demon before he obtained a boon, this demon, now having obtained a boon, would indeed devour the three worlds.
